scheme_name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship for Meritorious Girls
authority: Maulana Azad Education Foundation, Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India
benefit: ₹12,000 per annum for higher secondary / college study via direct DBT transfer

criteria.label: Female student identifier
criteria.plain_description: Scholarship is reserved exclusively for female students.
criteria.source_clause: Begum Hazrat Mahal Scheme Guidelines Clause 2(a)
criteria.remediation: Confirm student gender is female in profile or upload identity document.

criteria.label: Academic marks in qualifying examination (>= 55%)
criteria.plain_description: Student must have obtained at least 55% marks in aggregate in previous examination.
criteria.remediation: Upload previous class marksheet verifying aggregate marks >= 55%.

criteria.label: Annual family income ceiling (<= ₹2,00,000 per annum)
criteria.plain_description: Annual income of the student parents/guardian from all sources must not exceed ₹2.0 Lakh.
criteria.remediation: Upload valid digital Income Certificate issued by competent revenue authority (income <= ₹2 Lakh).

criteria.label: Aadhaar verified bank account for DBT
criteria.plain_description: Student must have Aadhaar number linked with active personal bank account.
criteria.remediation: Upload Aadhaar card seeded with student bank account.

application.office_name: Ministry of Minority Affairs / School Nodal Officer
documents_to_carry: Original Income Certificate from competent authority
Student Aadhaar Card and Bank Passbook
process_steps: Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) on NSP Portal
Select Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship Scheme
Upload Marksheet, Income Certificate, and Self-declaration
Institution Principal/Nodal Officer verifies online within 20 days
Ministry of Minority Affairs sanctions grant of ₹12,000/yr directly via DBT
